name: FM2-08523KTN256
summary: FM2-08523KTN256 is a frameless motor from Leadshine’s FM2 range for integration into robotic joint assemblies. The manufacturer lists 2.56 N·m rated torque and 10.8 N·m peak torque. Its frameless construction allows the rotor and stator to be integrated into an actuator designed by the equipment manufacturer.
